reviews.author: R Beard
reviews.text:
Many of these reviews are pertaining to Sales at Motor Inn of Carroll. Unfortunately, mine is regarding the service department.
Iowa does not have a good variety of Toyota Dealerships in the Des Moines Metro area. Living roughly an hour away from Carroll & Des Moines, and being jerked around with the Large Corporation of Toyota of Des Moines, I decided to take my business to a small town and small town dealership in hopes of a much better experience.

Cliff Note Version:
Called in, Spoke with Nathan Pudenz to get a quote for a series of fluid services, spark plugs, and serpentine belt. Quote received, and noticed an item was missing. Emailed back immediately, no acknowledgement. Called the next day, "I'll send that over". Still no email. Called the day before the appointment, provided a price over the phone. Day of appointment, called me to inform need new brakes, pads are low, I agree. 45 minutes before they close, I call to check status, says Belt had to be ordered, it'll be ready tomorrow. Was no one going to call me to inform? Next day, Spouse picks up vehicle, and bill was much larger than quoted price. Nathan removed labor for the missing brake fluid exchange on the quote, and applied 100.00 "Coupon". Still isn't adding up. I review the quote to the revised invoice. Charged higher than quote for Front/Rear Diff Service, and Transfer Case that was quoted over the phone.

Found Dave Bremser is the new GM as of 3 weeks ago, Nate Sporrer is the Service Manager, and included the Service Assistant, Amy, on an email regarding my recent experience with Nathan Pudenz.

Items that definitely need worked on, is communication, and better customer service skills (Phone and in Person), along with being sure the pricing is matching or very near the quoted price.

For future Consumers, Get all Quotes in Writing, so you're not surprised when picking up, and a completely different price. Some items were within a few dollars, which in my opinion, is acceptable. Some minor shop supplies could've happened.

Again, we elected a small town, small business owner to do business with versus the big corporation. However, this experience has left us with a bad impression. I look forward to the email response from the Service Manager and/or General Manager in order to rectify this situation and for me to update this review to show other consumers that this type of service, was a one off issue, and small town business wants to draw in consumers from excellent service within their service department.

8:30am on 8/13 - GM Called to acknowledge email and will be conducting review on their side. Will reach back out after review completed.

5pm on 8/13, Service Manager,  Nate called. Thanked for the detailed email and wanted to make the experience right. Due to the errors, offered gift certificate or a refund check. Opted for refund. Said will go out tomorrow. Once refund received, will update star rating.

Appreciate the prompt response and review of what had transpired. Hopefully no one will have to experience this in the future and again, Thank you Dave and Nate.

8/17- Refund received. Thank you to Nate and Dave for making this situation right.

Any future consumers, get all quotes in writing first before service is done!

reviews.text: Overall, not a great experience, especially with the financing agent Lisa. Besides the normal pushy sales approach without listening to what we wanted, they also neglected to tell us that they didn't accept electronic payments (even though there was a Point of Sale device right there on her desk). We then had to try to take out enough cash out of different ATM's and make numerous phone calls to our bank. When we said that we'd have to either cancel the purchase of the vehicle or come back another day, they were suddenly able to take electronic payments. When I mentioned that had that it would have saved a long of time and headache if she started with this, she just laughed and ignored us. When I asked why it was suddenly OK, she also just laughed. No apologies, no attempts at even trying to appear sorry. We could have been spared some unnecessary transaction fees if they had told us any of this before we made a several hour trip to them. Very unprofessional and inconsiderate to customers. Only getting 2 stars because the mechanic was quick and friendly.

reviews.author: Eli Kirlin
reviews.text:
I bought a 2014 Toyota Prius here a couple months back.

Within 400 miles of purchasing, a check engine light came on. I put my reader in the vehicle and got the code. After informing the salesman of the situation, he said it was a common issue with this year and all I needed to do was replace the gas cap.

After replacing the old gas cap with a brand new one, I was still left with the check engine light on and some even more worry some issues - revving up when idling and shaking.

I texted the salesman back once more to let him know his ‘fix’ didn’t 3work. I did not receive a response.

I understand that when buying a used vehicle it is ‘as is’. However, I find it a little odd that WITHIN 400 miles off the lot I am left with roughly a $1,000 fix.

I truly hope they did not use their authority as a dealership to erase the code thinking ‘it wasn’t a big deal’.

I hate leaving negative reviews, but am left with a bad taste in my mouth and no further communication with them.

Besides the above, I had talked with the salesman on over the phone and when asked if there was anything cosmetically wrong he replied ‘no, other than maybe a few scratches and door dings’. I found the door dings and scratches when I arrived and was still happy enough with the price point that I deemed the purchase still worth it.

After a 3 hour drive back and a few days worth of driving it and getting in and out, I noticed a portion of the side mirrors plastic casing was broken off, the drivers wheel well cover missing and the passenger’s wheel well cover broke. This bothers me mostly because of the fact that when you’re a certified dealer I’d assume some level of trustworthiness, which I was not given.

Overall, the cosmetic issues wouldn’t have made me give a negative review, but everything piled together created a very poor experience for me.
reviews.reply_text:
Motor Inn is a President Award Winning Dealership.  We believe in transparency & fair dealing.  Motor Inn was transperent in bringing to your attention the door dings & scratches prior to arriving.
We are aware that mechanical things have failure. They can be in perfect working condition one day & bad the next.  Just as you experienced with the check engine light coming on.  This vehicle was drivin by other employees & customers with no issues from a check engine light.  It is unfortunate that you experienced mechanical issues, but on an "as is" vehicle, Motor Inn changes the oil & checks for breaks & tops off all fluids.
Please  understand Motor Inn tries to avoid situations like this, and unfortunatly things happen out of our control after the fact.
Thank you

reviews.author: Joel Hoegh
reviews.text:
I would say it was easily the strangest experience in trying to trade vehicles.
I wanted to get ball park numbers to trade over the phone before I took the time to get an appointment and go to Carroll but that was refused.  They explained that they needed to see the vehicle even though it was one year old with 6000 miles.  I agreed and drove to Carroll and the vehicle was never examined or driven.  The only request was for the registration.  They took copies of it and I requested to talk business.  Reluctantly they offered me 8000 below KBB trade in Value and tried to sell me a used Vehicle for 2000 more than an equivalent new one.  Obviously I was disgusted and chose to leave.  Since then I have literally been laughing about the experience because the staff and management will be all new in a couple weeks anyway and I won’t be back anyway.  It’s kinda sad because I bought a new vehicle from that location in 2014 and it was actually a pretty good experience.  If I could award 0 stars in this circumstance I certainly would but it won’t let me so 1 will have to do. The only thing they really wanted was to get my name on a waiting list for a vehicle and not guarantee me any pricing.  Sounds like fancy Car dealer tricks.  All the risk on me and none on them.

reviews.text:
We purchased a new Toyota RAV4 Hybrid from Kyle at Motor Inn Toyota of Carroll. We were satisfied with the purchase and the process. The aspects we appreciated were at MSRP pricing , a refundable deposit process, no problems with outside financing, and no required add-ons.

This was the first time we purchased a vehicle not in dealer stock. There were some uncertainties on the Toyota transport  timing of our vehicle, and Kyle was super patient and professional while I explored other options beyond my reserved vehicle. In the end the timing turned out fine, and my wife loves the RAV4!! My wife and family that came along for the purchase commented on Kyle’s pleasant demeanor and knowledgeable orientation of the vehicle. We recommend Kyle and Motor Inn of Carroll!

Fast, efficient, and handled my needs. Before I headed to get the car, Hally, a member of dealership, reached out to make sure I didn't have any last minute questions. She was happy to get some addition (specific) pictures I had requested. On my way to get the car I felt more than confident with the deal. Hally also checked in to make sure I was safely on my way. Once I put my eyes on the car it was exactly as they stated if not better. I wouldn't hesitate to buy from this dealer again. reviews.text: I had been looking for a quality used Tahoe and found one on the internet at Motor Inn in Carroll, Iowa.  I called and spoke with Mark, the dealership manager about the vehicle.  He was very accommodating, so I decided to drive 200 miles to see the vehicle.  Upon arrival Mark put me in touch with Lorren, one of the salesmen at Motor Inn.  He already had the vehicle prepared for me to test drive and left my dad and I to ourselves to inspect and test drive the vehicle.  The quality of the vehicle was superior, they gave me a good price for my trade, and we were able to negotiate a good price without any confrontation.  All of the staff were very polite and helpful, including Dustin, the credit manager.  I highly recommend this dealership.
